note: Approximate generic nutrient values per 100 g edible portion. Visible food names are in English. The original 76 entries were rechecked and incomplete micronutrients were populated. The import also includes Nigerian/West African and Korean vegetables, fruits, staples, legumes, seeds, mushrooms, seaweeds, fermented foods, and oils that are often missing from generic databases. Units: kcal; protein/carbohydrate/sugar/fat/saturated fat/trans fat/fiber/salt in g; sodium/calcium/iron/potassium/magnesium/vitamin C in mg; vitamins A, D, and B12 in µg. Salt is calculated from sodium using salt = sodium × 2.5. Values are practical estimates and can vary by cultivar, product, recipe, fermentation, and preparation; proxy use is disclosed in each food's notes.
